name: playbook
description: Claude Code steering layer: you pick the goal and the mode in a picker, your decisions reach every agent verbatim and outrank every reviewer, an unease score built from hook evidence forces a rethink, then a judge, then you, guards hold unconfirmed dispatches and runaway review rounds, a pause after every review to weigh its findings against the spirit of your request, an always-on Sonnet-builds and Opus-judges model rule, teammates kept working until their part is done, calm compaction, a comment guard that refuses narration before it reaches your file, a status line showing the mode, crew messages and unease, and offline notifications via Pushover or ntfy.
